summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing routine PDMR transaction notifications under UK MAR. CEO Luke Miels, CFO Julie Brown, Group General Counsel James Ford and Chief Digital and Technology Officer Shobie Ramakrishnan each reported an increase in notional interest via dividend reinvestment under the Company's Deferred Annual Bonus Plan on October 12, 2026, at 17.3550 per ordinary share and in ADS, from dividends paid October 8, 2026. No special-situation event, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no deal terms apply; these are ordinary insider shareholding disclosures.
